name: validate
definition: Check whether an artifact, state transition, output, schema, claim, or runtime result matches explicit expectations before it can be promoted.
operator_form: candidate_result + expected_contract + validation_method -> validation_operation -> pass_fail_decision + evidence_record + next_action
acceptance_gates: No PASS without a command, schema, threshold, or reviewed verdict.
No schema validation without reporting failed fields.
No benchmark validation without baseline or threshold.
No claim validation without status tag.
No S1_TESTED status without persisted evidence.
failure_modes: LLM judgement is treated as final truth.
Proxy score is promoted as physical measurement.
Failed validation produces no next action.
next_target: Bind trajectory_trace_json -> schema plus semantic validator -> validation_report -> evidence_bundle -> VERDICT.
evidence_policy: Remain S0_REPO_FACT plus S5_PROXY until validation commands run and evidence is persisted.
